Python is a high-level programming language known for its simple syntax and readability. It is widely used in web development, automation, data analysis, and software development. Python supports object-oriented, functional, and procedural programming.

Popular Python libraries include NumPy, Pandas, and Flask. NumPy is mainly used for numerical computing and working with arrays. Pandas provides tools for data manipulation and analysis. Flask is a lightweight framework used to build web applications and APIs.

Python also plays an important role in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Developers use libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch to build machine learning models. These libraries provide tools for training models, making predictions, and processing data.

Python programs are executed by an interpreter. Variables store values, functions organize reusable code, and classes help developers create objects. Python also supports exception handling to manage errors during program execution.

Python is commonly used for automation because developers can write scripts to perform repetitive tasks. Examples include renaming files, processing spreadsheets, collecting website data, and automating system operations.
